decision: Before opening any complete author-trajectory scores, determine whether the LLM-based choice of training rows is necessary once the same device has returned labeled observations. Compare the frozen project and H-LLM author transfers to two simple full-data maintenance strategies on the same split, predictor, cases and label clock. Initial project/vote scores were known in development.
controls: Execute study_2.adaptive_batch_with_drift_detection_ddm unmodified, training the common single tree on all five labeled rows of the just-returned batch at its own DDM alarm. Also fit the same tree on the entire previous batch on a fixed schedule after every return, with no alarm, model calls or validation search. For each score both raw delivered decisions and the same source classifier bank with the same ObserverErrors updater. The first four fixed-schedule decisions can differ from drift-triggered decisions. Same ceiling of ten candidate fits per return, count actual fits and calls.
paired_diagnostic: If the author arm completes, additionally replay only its observed refit times with the full five rows. Fixing its refit times permits attributing raw prediction changes to filtering versus full-row replacement rather than divergence of the alarm clocks. Do not use this timing control as a deployable policy.
primary: Report Macro-F1 per physical board, worst true-class recall, paired correct/wrong differences, label count, training fits and real prompt calls. Four sensors share two exposure cycles per VOC. Interpret as method transfer on this apparatus. Keep full-source truth for scoring only.
adoption: Use the original gate (at least 0.01 Macro-F1 against the strongest attainable fixed control and mature comparator on every board, with worst recall no more than 0.02 lower). Decisions here select a candidate for independent confirmation, never replace competition weights with this nine-channel model.
